Static obstacle for UGV perception and parking; no aerial dynamics or spinning rotors.

Default real layout (2026-11-13) uses DICT_4X4_50 IDs 14 (entry +y_sim / -x_gz, pitched ~25 deg), 6 (+x_sim / +y_gz side), and 3 (-x_sim / -y_gz side); a fourth -y_sim/+x_gz card was unreadable behind wires and is omitted. Cards are 50mm black squares with ~1.5mm bottom quiet zone. Legacy layout (9, 12, 13, 14) stays selectable.

These values describe the built photo model. Only deck_diameter and skid_center_spacing currently directly drive geometry; other detail coordinates are authored in drone_model.py and are not independent scaling controls.
Landing gear has exactly TWO splayed tubes: one from each skid center to the central deck, as shown in photos. Default model has 3 readable marker cards (14, 6, 3); legacy layout has 4.
